events.name: Madahoochi 30th Anniversary
events.info: MadahoochiOctober 24, 2026Atomic GarageDoors: 8:00PMShow: 8:30PMThirty years of music, friendship, memories, family, mayhem, and unforgettable moments on and off stage is something worth celebrating. Madahoochi has been delivering original music providing those moments, and bringing people together in the St. Louis area and around the midwest for three decades now and we invite you to celebrate with us at Atomic By Jamo on October 24.Combining notes and elements of rock, blues, world beat, funk, and much more with pop sensibilities, soaring harmonies, and well crafted original songs, Madahoochi has been one of the quintessential midwestern genre bending and description defying bands on the scene for as long as most can remember. Over the span of 3 full length original albums and multiple EP releases, and the legendary Live in the Loop live album, countless tour stops throughout the midwest, countless mind blowing experimental and improvisational jams while being a must-see, high energy late night fixture on the festival circuit, their legendary Madahoochi Monday parties at Ciceros, and more Madahoochi has created a legacy and culture of joy and community amongst their loyal following.Over the last 30 years, there have been incredible hi-lights and unforgettable moments with the Hooch. In a time where the festival circuit was vast and impressive in the midwestern portion of the country, Madahoochi was a key part of several of these large- scale, multi-day events, including raging sets at Wakarusa, 10K Lakes, Salmon Fest, and MoRoots. Who could forget the amazing summer night under the Arch opening for Little Feat in front of an amazing throng of St. Louis music freaks on the steps and by the river?. We could fill pages with fond memories of these amazing musical moments. The legacy and lore of the Hooch grew with their hi-wire act and legendary live performances which were built around the amazing original catalogue of music as well as their undeniable synergy and chemistry with the audience.Like anything that is finely crafted and pure, that takes time, effort and continuity. So. just try to imagine having a weekly Monday night musical residency in a basement venue room in a low ceiling club every monday night for years starting at 9pm in a dark shotgun room packed full of frenzied fans, friends, local musicians, curious onlookers, industry folks drinking on their night off and more all singing along and losing their minds.. EVERY Monday night. For years, thats exactly what Madahoochi did with their Madahoochi mondays at Ciceros. Playing high energy, multi-set, and original shows that were so vibrant and important that several of those shows were recorded and later released as the Live in the Loop album. You can hear the audience screaming and calling for more between songs over and over again. Its a glimpse into the mysticism and magic of a time period in the St. Louis music scene.. AND it was always on a Monday night. Those weekly Mondays helped to create a vast, loyal, caring, and communal following who still loves this band 30 years later.

events.name: Squeaky Feet
events.info: Squeaky Feet November 12, 2026 8:00 PM Atomic Garage Age 21+ TICKETS- $15 GA Standing ADV $20 GA Standing DOS Squeaky Feet is redefining the prog rock & jam-band experience with their electrifying blend of progressive rock, jazz fusion, and dance grooves. Combining inspiration from giants such as King Crimson, Weather Report, Pink Floyd, Steely Dan, and Rush with the modern improvisational ethos of Phish, Umphrey's McGee, and Dopapod, the Denver-based quintet captivates audiences with high-energy performances that transcend genre boundaries. Seamlessly weaving triumphant solos, intricate rhythms, and exploratory improvisation, Squeaky Feet delivers a sonic journey that leaves listeners enthralled and live audiences in awe. Founded in 2019 by Berklee College of Music alumni, Squeaky Feet has rapidly built a devoted fanbase, thanks to their unparalleled musicianship and innovative approach to live performances. The band's lineup---Colin Shore (guitar/vocals), Greg King (guitar), Jimmy Finnegan (bass/vocals), Brian Keller (keyboards/sax/flute/vocals), and Kevin D'Angelo (drums)---showcases a collective virtuosity that sets them apart in the jam scene.
